title: Commonworld Atlas list page
description: One page of 50 published entries (/api/v1/atlas/page/{page}.json, /api/v1/atlas/categories/{category}/page/{page}.json, /api/v1/atlas/platforms/page/{page}.json for the A-Z list). Start at page 1 and follow `next` until `has_more` is false. Every page of one build carries the same `snapshot_id`; if it changes between two pages, the list was rebuilt in between: start again from page 1. A page number past the last page returns HTTP 404. Added in schema_version 1.8.0.

generated_at.description: Time the source data snapshot was produced.

newest_observation.description: Newest observed_at of any published claim; can be later than generated_at when claims were amended after the snapshot.

snapshot_id.description: Id of the published list: the same on every page of one build; it changes when an entry is added, removed or changed, not with the daily link-safety check or a new screenshot.

has_more.description: true when a next page exists.

next.description: URL of the next page, or null on the last page.

prev.description: URL of the previous page, or null on page 1.

full_list.description: The complete list in one file (platforms.json or the category file).
